value.rationale: The three smallest nontrivial power-nullcone cardinalities separate all five characteristic-two modular group algebras of order eight, while geometric reducibility separates dihedral and quaternion cubic loci. This is a natural algebra isomorphism invariant and distinguishes nil exponent from radical ideal nilpotency; not an arbitrary enumeration.
